entities.name: Helen Thompson Gaige
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Helen Beulah Thompson Gaige was an American herpetologist, curator of Reptiles and Amphibians for the Museum of Zoology at the University of Michigan, and a specialist in neotropical frogs.
